title: Enforce live outbound permission and customer scope across stock-out routes
description:
Stage3 core inventory closure. Use genuine authenticated existing ERP permissions; no new user grants or anonymous/admin fallback. Retain inventory source document audit and original failed logs. Run relevant unit tests and safe Release build/full unit suite. Real SQL must target exact (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with IntegratedSecurity and a new GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject existing/wrong target before access, never drop/reset or read production settings. Include two independent connection race tests where applicable. Build completion never implies stage acceptance.

2026-10-13 verified acceptance recovery: StockOutController.GetById:68-74 loads receipt row before StockOutAuthorizationRules.EnsureCustomerAuthorizedAsync, and GetMovements:82-83 loads before same check. An unknown id yields NotFound while an existing id yields Unauthorized/Forbidden for missing/disabled/deleted/no-menu caller, contrary to original live stock-out menu before every detail/movement route. Require existing EnsureMenuAuthorizedAsync before any stock-out/source read or lock on all entries, then retain authoritative current customer checks inside deterministic transaction/source locks. No new grants, no source reassignment, unchanged stock quantities/cost/ledger/return/loading reversal guards. Remove exemptions completely, including no HttpContext; parse missing actor safely to null for controlled Unauthorized. No internal-call/test-compatibility exceptions or renamed bypass. Adapt fixtures only with genuine enabled identities/existing grants/live masters in isolated databases. Retain original numeric/source/customer/transaction/audit checks. Missing/disabled/no-menu users must be rejected before counts or any business query. Preserve full logs; use explicit .ai/logs/ERP-370 results/TRX directories. Safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors/full units plus real isolated SQL mandatory; no whole-stage claim.
acceptance_criteria: Require live enabled current user and actual stock-out menu before every controller list/detail/movement/options/create/update/submit/approve/cancel/delete route. Use authoritative CustomerId and existing SalespersonDataScopeService, database scope before counts/pagination. Enforce both stored and proposed customer before edit assignment; no missing-identity, restricted-unmapped or legacy-unlinked global fallback. Restrict source/order/warehouse evidence to existing legitimate privileges, no new grants or inferred warehouse ownership.

Apply compatible source-sales-order/stock-out deterministic row lock and atomic transaction to state/edit/delete operations so approved stock/ledger cannot race edits. Preserve ERP343 source quantity limits, ERP359 approved-return and ERP367 loading reversal guards. Failed authorization/proposed detail update or later posting leaves original document/stock/ledger unchanged; approval never duplicates inventory. Test actual controller SQL own/foreign/null source, revoked menu, disabled user, denied movement evidence, failed edit unchanged and concurrent edit/state transitions; retain existing fulfillment and ledger tests.
